exposure: continuation of low-molecular-weight heparin (LMWH) in the peripartum
switching from low-molecular-weight heparin (LMWH) to unfractionated heparin (UFH) in the peripartum
cohort: The study included 189 anticoagulated pregnant women who delivered at the University of Illinois at Chicago Hospital and Health Science System between 2005 and 2016.
finding: Anesthesia type and the rate of bleeding complications were similar between women who continued LMWH and those who switched to UFH during the peripartum.
